scenarios.title: Create customer
scenarios.assertion: A synthetic customer is saved and can be found after navigating away and back.

scenarios.title: Search and filter
scenarios.assertion: The chosen fixture appears under its matching customer report filter.

scenarios.title: Contact association
scenarios.assertion: A synthetic contact is associated with the intended customer.

scenarios.title: Activity history
scenarios.assertion: The selected synthetic activity is visible under that customer.

scenarios.title: Required-field validation
scenarios.assertion: The chosen required field is enforced without saving an incomplete record; verify the configured rule before running.
